payload.title: File:Howesia browni (SAM-PK-K10180, braincase).jpg
payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman, C. Browning, M. Tshibalanganda, D. Mukherjee, R. M. H. Smith, A. Du Plessis & F. Wolvaardt
payload.credit_html: "Micro-CT informed cranial anatomy of the early rhynchosaur Howesia browni, with implications for rhynchosaur skull evolution"
payload.description_html: μCT-derived reconstruction of the braincase of Howesia browni SAM-PK-K10180 in: A, left lateral; B, right lateral; C, dorsal; D, ventral; E, posterior view. F, medial view after digital removal of the left prootic and exoccipital. Note that the paths of the internal carotid arteries were not reconstructed in the renderings, but have been indicated based on their identification from the raw μCT data. Bones are labelled; other relevant morphological structures are marked in bold and underlined. Abbreviations: aip, anterior inferior process; bo, basioccipital; bptp, basipterygoid process; bt, basal tuber; clp, clinoid process; cn, cranial nerve; cral; crista alaris; cup, cultriform process; ds, dorsum sellae; eo, exoccipital; feo, fenestra ovalis; hpf, hypophyseal fossa; ica; internal carotid artery; mpr, median pharyngeal recess; oc, occipital condyle; op, opisthotic; pbs, parabasisphenoid; plr, pseudolagenar recess; pnf, pneumatic foramina; pni, pneumatic indentation; pop, paroccipital process; ppc, paroccipital process contribution; pr, prootic; r, ridge; so, supraoccipital; stg, stapedial groove; vei, vestibular indentation; vr, ventral ramus. Scale bar represents 10 mm.
